name: Tdarr
description: Tdarr is a distributed transcoding system for media libraries. It scans movies and series, checks file health, and remuxes or transcodes them with FFmpeg or HandBrake according to the rules you set. A server keeps the library and plugin stack, and nodes on this machine or others do the work. It is built to sit next to Sonarr, Radarr, and Jellyfin.
author: HaveAGitGat

form_fields.label: Security > Enable authentication
form_fields.hint: Tdarr 3 requires a sign-in by default. Turn this off only when the web UI and server port are not reachable by anyone else.

form_fields.label: Security > API key secret
form_fields.hint: Generated once. The admin password and the internal node API key are tapi_ plus this value, for example tapi_ followed by the hex shown here. Sign in as admin, then change the password in the web UI if you want it to differ from the API key. Do not change this after the first start.

form_fields.label: Node > Enable internal node
form_fields.hint: Run a transcode node inside the server container. Leave this on for a single-machine install, the same way a normal *arr app runs on one host.

form_fields.label: Node > Node name
form_fields.hint: Name shown for the internal node on the Tdarr tab.

form_fields.label: Node > FFmpeg version
form_fields.hint: FFmpeg major version the container downloads on startup. Use 7 (current Tdarr Docker example) or 6.

form_fields.label: Node > CPU transcode workers
form_fields.hint: CPU workers started with the internal node. Applied again on each start. 2 is a safe start on a small server.

form_fields.label: Node > GPU transcode workers
form_fields.hint: GPU workers started with the internal node. Leave at 0 unless the host GPU is passed into the container. This package does not mount /dev/dri or an NVIDIA GPU, so a GPU worker would have nothing to use.

form_fields.label: Node > CPU health-check workers
form_fields.hint: Workers that scan files for corruption. 1 is enough for most libraries.

form_fields.label: Node > GPU health-check workers
form_fields.hint: GPU health-check workers. Leave at 0 unless a GPU is passed into the container.

form_fields.label: Node > Poll interval (ms)
form_fields.hint: How often the internal node asks the server for work.

form_fields.label: Node > Priority
form_fields.hint: Worker priority. -1 means no priority. 0 is the highest priority, then 1, and so on.

form_fields.label: Node > Start paused
form_fields.hint: Start the internal node paused so it does not pick up jobs until you resume it in the web UI.

form_fields.label: Logs > Max log size (MB)
form_fields.hint: Tdarr rotates its own log files at this size.

form_fields.label: Plugins > Update schedule
form_fields.hint: Optional cron expression for automatic community plugin updates. Leave empty to update plugins yourself from the web UI.
